choices.label: Ask Morris to secure the gate
choices.impact: Morris keeps Amara safe at the house while David follows the trail. Morris can watch for danger, but he needs you to share each clue before he can act.
choices.response: Morris keeps Amara safe at the house while David follows the trail. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Decode the next lead with Amara
choices.impact: David checks the technical evidence. Amara connects it to the people and history behind the records, without police assistance.
choices.response: David preserves the original record and tests the next connection while Amara checks its meaning against what she remembers.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Follow the footprints quietly
choices.impact: David approaches quietly while Amara waits for his next call. You can investigate quietly, but no one will be close enough to help immediately if Victor is waiting.
choices.response: David approaches quietly while Amara waits for his next call. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: David

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: The mud ends here, David. Victor knew I would follow, but he missed one thing: I heard the gate slam before the car reached the road.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Then the gate is our first clue. We will search every footprint until we know which way he took Ethan.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I found a key near the fence. If it belongs to Victor, it may tell us what he opened before he left.

police.speaker: David
police.text: Morris has secured the garden gate. He asks me to photograph the first clue before I move it.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: I have isolated the number that called her. We search the garden for something that matches its location.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: The footprints end by the garden fence. I send Amara a photograph before I follow them.
